# Jeebis Shell source

This source tree is based on the Tide Island 1.0.49 release source, SHA-256
`d6a9828834b52248db1f820bbfa3d8960563c1d166c7381946c366038e77d24f`.
The initial import incorporates the dotfiles package's patch and source
adaptation steps. The release license and upstream notices are included.

Runtime shell changes belong in this tree. The Nix package renders directional
key tokens using the shared key layout and retains the existing service,
configuration paths and command names.
